description_en: Obtains temporary credentials for a partner to assume a user's service-linked role
description_zh: 合作伙伴获取用户SLR角色授权临时凭证
kebab_example: aliyun websitebuild get-user-tmp-identity-for-partner --biz-id WD20250703155602000001 --user-id 1231331311 --auth-purpose BindDomain --service-linked-role AliyunServiceRoleForSasCspm --extend 'deliveryNodeName_:_视觉设计确认_,_deliveryNodeStatus_:_Reject_,_deliveryOperatorRole_:_Customer' --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetUserTmpIdentityForPartner

parameters.help_en: The business ID of the customer
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en:
The service-linked role.
> For information about the service-linked roles supported by ApsaraDB RDS, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/342840.html
parameters.help_zh:
服务关联角色。
> RDS支持的服务关联角色，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/342840.html
parameters.name: service_linked_role

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether fuzzy match is supported for port numbers. Set this parameter to **1** to enable fuzzy match. Other values or an empty value indicate that fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 端口号是否支持模糊查询。要设置支持模糊查询时，请将该参数的取值设置为**1**，其他值或取值为空则表示不支持模糊查询
parameters.name: extend
